descriptor: An application that automates data processing from Excel/CSV uploads to generate actionable business insights and alerts for small business owners.

requirements.statement: The system must allow users to upload Excel or CSV files for data processing.
The system must clean and preprocess uploaded data to ensure accuracy.
The system must calculate KPIs from the cleaned data.
The system must generate a dashboard displaying calculated KPIs and insights.
The system must send alerts and actionable insights to users via email and Slack.
The system must integrate with Excel, Google Sheets, Slack, Gmail, Outlook, QuickBooks, Dropbox, and Google Drive.
The system must provide subscription plans with different upload limits: Free, $9/month, $19/month, $39/month, $79/month.
The system must stop and ask for clarification when unsure about a KPI calculation or insight.
The system must assign an evidence level to each KPI: high, medium, or low confidence.
The system must maintain a record of insights and allow users to undo changes.
The system must provide user feedback mechanisms on insight accuracy.
The system must generate summary reports showing decisions made.
The system must verify significant drops or increases in KPIs before sending alerts.
The system must support users with limited tech skills through simple dashboards.
The system must handle data from customer feedback, sales trends, inventory levels, recurring revenue metrics, business facts, and subscription history.
The system must provide detailed reports for teams of analysts.
The system must ensure data accuracy and integrity throughout the process.
Every data upload screen must allow users to complete the upload process in three steps or fewer.

releases.name: Dashboard and Insights

releases.name: Integrations and Subscription Management

releases.goal: Implement error handling, evidence levels, and detailed reporting.

releases.goal: Enhance user feedback mechanisms and improve user interface.
releases.name: User Feedback and Experience Enhancements

stories.title: Upload and Clean Data
stories.narrative: As a business owner, I want to upload Excel files and have them cleaned automatically, so that I can ensure data accuracy.
acceptance: Given an Excel file, when I upload it, then the system cleans the data.
Given a malformed Excel file, when I upload it, then the system reports an error.
Trust: The system logs the data cleaning process.
stories.task_guidance: Implement file upload endpoint and data cleaning service.

stories.title: Calculate KPIs
stories.narrative: As a business owner, I want KPIs calculated from my data, so that I can understand my business performance.
acceptance: Given cleaned data, when KPIs are calculated, then they are displayed correctly.
Given incomplete data, when KPIs are calculated, then the system requests clarification.
Trust: The system logs KPI calculations and evidence levels.
stories.task_guidance: Develop KPI calculation module and integrate with data cleaning output.

stories.title: Display Dashboard
stories.narrative: As a business owner, I want a dashboard displaying my KPIs, so that I can easily monitor my business.
acceptance: Given calculated KPIs, when I access the dashboard, then they are displayed clearly.
Given no KPIs, when I access the dashboard, then it shows a message indicating no data.
Trust: The system logs dashboard access and interactions.
stories.task_guidance: Design and implement a user-friendly dashboard interface.

stories.title: Send Alerts and Insights
stories.narrative: As a business owner, I want to receive alerts and insights, so that I can take timely actions.
acceptance: Given significant KPI changes, when they occur, then the system sends an alert via email.
Given no significant changes, when I check alerts, then no new alerts are sent.
Trust: The system logs all alerts sent and their contents.
stories.task_guidance: Set up email and Slack notification services.

stories.title: Synchronize Financial Data for Accurate Reporting
stories.narrative: As a financial analyst, I want to synchronize data from Google Sheets and QuickBooks, so that I can ensure accurate financial reporting.
acceptance: Given data is available in Google Sheets and QuickBooks, when synchronization is initiated, then the data should be accurately reflected in the system.
Given a failure in data synchronization, when the system retries, then the synchronization should complete successfully without data loss.
Trust: Every synchronization attempt must be logged with a timestamp and status.
stories.task_guidance: Implement data synchronization using the Google Sheets API and QuickBooks API. Ensure data integrity checks are in place.

stories.title: Manage Subscription Plans
stories.narrative: As a business owner, I want to manage my subscription plan, so that I can control my costs and usage.
acceptance: Given a subscription plan, when I select it, then my account is updated accordingly.
Given an expired plan, when I try to upload data, then the system prompts for renewal.
Trust: The system logs all subscription changes and usage.
stories.task_guidance: Implement subscription management module with payment processing.

stories.title: Handle KPI Calculation Uncertainty
stories.narrative: As a business owner, I want the system to handle uncertainty in KPI calculations, so that I can trust the insights provided.
acceptance: Given uncertain KPI calculations, when they occur, then the system requests clarification.
Given a KPI with low confidence, when displayed, then it shows the evidence level.
Trust: The system logs all uncertainty handling and evidence levels.
stories.task_guidance: Enhance KPI calculation module to include uncertainty handling and evidence levels.

stories.title: Generate Summary Reports
stories.narrative: As a business owner, I want summary reports of decisions made, so that I can review business actions.
acceptance: Given business actions, when a report is generated, then it includes all relevant decisions.
Given no actions, when a report is generated, then it indicates no actions taken.
Trust: The system logs all report generation activities.
stories.task_guidance: Develop report generation module to summarize business actions.

stories.title: Collect User Feedback on Insights
stories.narrative: As a business owner, I want to provide feedback on insights, so that the system can improve its accuracy.
acceptance: Given an insight, when I provide feedback, then the system records it.
Given no feedback, when I check insights, then the system prompts for feedback.
Trust: The system logs all feedback received and its impact.
stories.task_guidance: Implement feedback collection mechanism linked to insights.

stories.title: Enhance User Interface for Simplicity
stories.narrative: As a business owner with limited tech skills, I want a simple interface, so that I can use the system easily.
acceptance: Given the dashboard, when accessed, then it is simple and intuitive.
Given a complex interface, when simplified, then user satisfaction increases.
Trust: The system logs user interactions and feedback on interface changes.
stories.task_guidance: Redesign user interface to enhance simplicity and usability.

stories.title: Establish Trust Spine for Data Processing
stories.narrative: As a system administrator, I want to ensure data processing is reliable and auditable, so that data integrity is maintained.
acceptance: Given data is processed, when a processing error occurs, then the system should retry the operation without duplicating data.
Given data processing is complete, when an audit is conducted, then all processing steps should be logged with timestamps.
Trust: Every data processing step must be logged with a unique identifier and status.
stories.task_guidance: Implement logging for each data processing step, ensuring idempotency and auditability.

stories.title: Verify KPI Changes Before Alerting
stories.narrative: As a business analyst, I want to verify significant KPI changes before alerts are sent, so that false alarms are minimized.
acceptance: Given a significant change in KPI, when the system detects the change, then it should verify the change before sending an alert.
Given a false positive KPI change, when verification fails, then no alert should be sent.
Trust: Every KPI change verification must be logged with the result and timestamp.
stories.task_guidance: Implement a verification mechanism for KPI changes before triggering alerts.

stories.title: Generate Detailed Reports for Analysts
stories.narrative: As an analyst, I want detailed reports generated, so that I can perform in-depth analysis.
acceptance: Given data is available, when report generation is initiated, then a detailed report should be produced with all relevant metrics.
Given incomplete data, when report generation is attempted, then the system should notify the user of missing data.
Trust: Every report generation must be logged with the parameters used and timestamp.
stories.task_guidance: Design report templates and implement report generation logic using available data sources.

stories.title: Maintain Record of Insights with Undo Capability
stories.narrative: As a user, I want to maintain a record of insights and be able to undo changes, so that I can manage insights effectively.
acceptance: Given an insight is recorded, when a change is made, then the system should allow the user to undo the change.
Given a user attempts to undo a change, when the change is reversible, then the system should restore the previous state.
Trust: Every insight change and undo action must be logged with a timestamp.
stories.task_guidance: Implement a version control mechanism for insights allowing undo operations.
